heading: INT. FUNERAL HOME - VIEWING ROOM - AFTERNOON

units.text: INT. FUNERAL HOME - VIEWING ROOM - AFTERNOON
Pale carpet, folding chairs in rows, a coffin at the front under a spray of white lilies.
Muffled organ music from a hidden speaker.
A table of finger sandwiches no one has touched.
THEODORA ACHTERBERG, 60s, black dress, stands at the casket with one hand on its edge, her face composed in the way of someone who has practiced.

Her sons stand apart: the elder, GABRIEL ACHTERBERG, 40s, rigid in a dark suit, jaw clenched, by the guest book; the younger, SEBASTIAN ACHTERBERG, 30s, unshaven, tie askew, near the exit with his phone in his hand.
In the second row, a stranger in a rain-soaked coat, MAEVE KIRWAN-SOTO, 30s, sits very straight with a toddler asleep against her shoulder.
And at the back, leaning on a cane, the old family friend ARCHIBALD PELLEGRINI, 80s, watches them all with milky, intelligent eyes.
Sebastian glances at the stranger, and at the toddler.
Gabriel follows his gaze and the muscle in his cheek jumps.
Theodora does not turn her head.
She smooths a ribbon on the casket with her thumb, and her other hand drifts to the edge of the lilies, crushing a petal between two fingers.
Who invited her?
units.name: GABRIEL

units.text: Nobody.
units.name: SEBASTIAN

units.text: She can't be here.
units.name: GABRIEL

units.text: She's already here, Gabe.
units.name: SEBASTIAN

units.text: Gabriel crosses the aisle in three long strides.
Maeve looks up, calm.
The child stirs and settles.
I'm going to have to ask you to leave.
units.name: GABRIEL

units.text: I came to pay respects.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: You didn't know him.
units.name: GABRIEL

units.text: I did.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Not like that.
units.name: GABRIEL

units.text: Exactly like that.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Theodora crosses the room, heels silent on the carpet.
She stops between them.
Looks at Maeve, then at the toddler, a long and unreadable look, and then she touches the child's hair with the back of one finger.
What is her name?
units.name: THEODORA

units.text: Dorothea.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Theodora closes her eyes.
When she opens them, they are wet and furious and kind all at once.
After his mother.
units.name: THEODORA

units.text: ^ Mother, don't.
units.name: GABRIEL

units.text: ^ Mom, let it go.
units.name: SEBASTIAN

units.text: Sit down. All of you.
units.name: THEODORA

units.text: They sit, one by one.
Archibald, by the door, lowers himself slowly into a chair and sets his cane across his knees.
The organ music swells and then fades.
Theodora takes the empty seat beside Maeve, and puts her arm around the sleeping child's back.
